`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- More retries also means a longer worst case when the tide source is down. If the script waits between attempts, the extra wait depends on the delay. A fixed delay adds 2 more delays. Exponential backoff (a delay that doubles each attempt) adds the 2 longest delays.
- Check what "retries" means in the loop. Some loops make 5 attempts in total. Others make 1 attempt plus 5 retries, which is 6 in total.
